title: danger cancel primary when not recommended
rule: If the user's intention is delete, use danger to warn. If the system does not recommend the deletion, set Cancel as the primary action. Compatible with "primary not destructive"; dual-cite, don't collapse.
pass_when: Delete uses danger warning. When the system does not recommend deletion, Cancel is the primary; destructive is not the recommended/primary.
fail_when: Delete is primary when the system does not recommend it; or danger/primary collapsed so destructive is the recommended path.
overview: Delete uses danger styling; Cancel is primary when deletion is not recommended.
apply_when: Ant delete confirms where the system discourages the deletion.
not_when: Recommended safe primary actions that are not destructive deletes.
agent_hint: Style delete as danger; when discouraged, make Cancel primary—not delete.
description: If the user’s intention is delete, use danger styling to warn. When the system does not recommend deletion, Cancel should be the primary and destructive must not be the recommended path. Making delete primary while discouraging it collapses that safeguard. Pair with the general rule that primary is not destructive; Ant adds the Cancel-as-primary case when deletion is discouraged.
do_not_claim: A second invented rule beyond this cite + `actions.buttons.default_not_destructive`. Overlap with Actions 40: `actions.buttons.default_not_destructive`.
